notes.title: Airscape Update 1.0.2 - Linux and completion fixes
notes.notes:
Changelog:

-Linux support should now be fully functional, with working achievements. However, the Steam Overlay/screenshots are currently not working.
-15-02 can now be completed (Really sorry to anyone who was stuck on this)
-Fixed orb counts in 17-06,17-06, and 17-07.
-Fixed the unobtainable orb in 11-01.
-Fixed misplaced laser in 1-1.

notes.title: Airscape Update 1.0.1 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We hope you're enjoying the game! Unfortunately, 1.0.0 had a bug which caused all adjustable settings (Music volume, rotation rate etc.) to default to zero. This can be fixed by adjusting those settings manually, but it was annoying and confusing for anyone playing for the first time.

After the fix, starting from a new save slot, or starting from scratch, should work as intended.

Enjoy!

notes.title: So Far, So Good Airscape: The Fall Of Gravity
notes.notes:
Aw man, this is one of the best physics games I’ve seen, if only half-glimpsed in trailer form. And O the things these crusty, jaded eyes have had to clock their gaze on. A game in which gravity is so changeable I legitimately don’t understand what is going on. That’s Airscape: The Fall of Gravity [official site].

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Airscape: The Fall of Gravity will be released August 11th!
notes.notes:
Hello world!

We're thrilled to announce that Airscape: The Fall of Gravity will be released August 11th 2015! After almost four years of tireless work to bring you the best action platformer humanly (octopusly?) possible, we're a mere few weeks away from finally being able to share the game with the world!

Thanks for visiting our Steam page! We'd love it if you added Airscape to your Steam Wishlist, and be sure to spread the news to all of your friends!

To be notified about the latest Airscape news and to be notified when the game launches, follow us on Twitter at [url=http://twitter.com/AirscapeGame]@Airscapegame[/url] or on [url=https://www.facebook.com/airscapegame]Facebook[/url].

To get a closer look at development, follow me on Twitter at [url=http://twitter.com/JustASquid]@JustASquid[/url].

Cheers!
